snippet.title: A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe is a point-and-click adventure game about a Giraffe attempting to live his day-to-day life while not talking to anyone.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071440/A_Week_in_the_Life_of_Asocial_Giraffe/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
